drafts.draft_en:
Hey @grok, a Philly landlord just paid off the mortgage on a rental rowhome.

Make the case for keeping it free and clear.
Then make the case for pulling cash out to buy a second property.

Which one builds more for the next generation over 20 years? Real numbers only.
drafts.pattern: Argue-both-sides ask (@incomeetfguy) + 'real numbers only' (@iAnonPatriot, 27.2k) + build-your-legacy angle. Hypothetical landlord; let Grok run the numbers and you correct them.
drafts.video_tip: 15s outside a rowhome: hold up a key, 'Paid off. Now what?' Read both options on screen as A/B. End: 'Let's see what Grok says, then I'll tell you what I'd do.' Burned-in captions; quote-post Grok's reply.

drafts.draft_en:
Hey @grok, a 58-year-old in Delaware County owns her home free and clear, plans to retire in 7 years, and has almost nothing else saved.

Give me a realistic year-by-year plan to turn that house into retirement income without losing it.
drafts.pattern: Mortgage/family + 'year-by-year survival plan' template (@solopribuilds 1.12M; @renegadegenesis copy 8.9k in ~8h), moved to a house-rich, cash-poor homeowner in Bar's market. Hypothetical person, educational.
drafts.video_tip: Screen-record typing the question into X, cut to Grok's answer, then a 30s selfie reaction: 'Here's the one step Grok missed.' Overlay text: 'House rich, cash poor?'

drafts.draft_en:
Real estate is not passive income. It's a business.

Most bad deals I see start the same way: the buyer priced the offer before pricing the repairs.

Roof. Mechanicals. Water. Foundation. Price those first, then the offer.

What repair surprised you the most on a deal?
drafts.pattern: Contrarian 'real estate is NOT passive' take (@DividendMil) with a line-item list, ending in a reply-bait question. No dollar figures or ARV rule claims, so nothing to verify; if you add the 65% rule, say purchase plus repairs, wholesale/flip only.
drafts.video_tip: Walkthrough clip of a distressed property: point at roof, panel, basement water line, foundation crack, one word on screen for each. 20s max, ending on the question. Captions burned in.
